title: Windows-Orchestrator
description: PowerShell Start-Process / Prozessgruppen-Management, getrennte Sessions, Timeouts, Exitcodes, JSON-Protokoll, Wiederanlauf, Circuit Breaker. Gate: 3 Dummy-Tasks plus Abbruch-/Resume-Test erfolgreich.

evidenceRequirements.description: PowerShell orchestrator script created with process management, timeouts, JSON protocol
Agent role prompts/policies created for Planner, Builder, Reviewer, Fixer
3 Dummy tasks executed successfully with proper exit codes and JSON output
Abort/Resume test passes - orchestrator can recover from interruption
Circuit breaker triggers on repeated failures

acceptanceCriteria: PowerShell orchestrator script manages separate OpenCode sessions per role
Process groups, timeouts, exit codes properly handled
Circuit breaker prevents infinite retry loops
